decision.explanation: The sources explicitly identify four distinct positions held by Barbara Boxer: 'former United States Senator from California' (D1S4, D2S2), 'member of the United States House of Representatives' (D2S8), 'Marin County Board of Supervisors' (D2S7), and 'Teachta Dála' (D1S4). While the text mentions committee memberships (D2S13) and advocacy roles (D2S9, D2S12), these are attributes of her Senate tenure rather than separate primary positions held in the same capacity as the elected/appointed offices listed. The proposal 'Member of the Dáil Éireann' is semantically equivalent to 'Teachta Dála' (the specific title used in the text) and is thus redundant. Other proposals describe activities or roles within the main positions rather than distinct titles.
